title: Ruins Galore
description: this mod adds 5 new ruin structures to minecraft with good loot.
body:
this mod adds 5 new ruin structures to minecraft with good loot. Its the perfect mod for a server owner who wants to add a little fun to minecraft without it being too big. these spawn uncommonly but they arent rare. there are more variants coming soon but for now there is 5.

1. **Badlands**
2. **Snowy Plains**
3. **Jungle(_rarest_)**
4. **Dark Forest**
5. **Desert**
